title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements, tolerances, test methods, and compliance specifications for Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements as prescribed under IS 616 by the Bureau of Indian Standards.

marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
